title: Shared this on a social and got told about this forum. 😲
content: I'm not sure I've ever had the mall dream before but who knows.. i dream vividly a lot. Here's what I shared on my other post that got me referred here. One thing I don't mention in the op is how very lucid it felt in that I was choosing my own adventure almost every step of the way. It was very much like an open world rpg that I was developing in real time. Another thing was it felt very dingy... like not a pretty space, dim lighting and musty. "Just took a 30 minute nap and had EXTREMELY lucid dreams. Irl I'm parked in the middle of nowhere Arizona and in the dream I could hear a bunch of people gathering in a line to order pizza and Matt was like "oh great, I could eat" but I was like" there's no restaurants here, I'm just dreaming." 😅 And I walked towards the kitchen doors where Matt was like, "you can't go in there" and i said "fuck it I'm dreaming, let's find out what's in here!" Lol. And like every time I would enter a new section of this dream it would pause and load up the environs and I was like "oh man... i guess we do live in a simulation." And things kept looking the way they do in ai art... too many fingers on hands, little kids covered in tattoos. 😅 but overall the whole thing was just a big mall without shops. There were lots of family amusement types of things, bowling lanes with connected water slides. An entire area where people I know were just in a huge mashed up crowd waiting to say hi to me, like a concert crowd but no band and every time I went to say pardon me to move an inch it was another person I haven't seen in years. One room was empty and I was like, I want this to be a casino and suddenly a woman appeared with a card table and welcomed us with a bunch of gaming chips. But the best and most amazing part of my dream was the very end just before my alarm rang... my grandma church was standing there with some other little old ladies all dressed up in their Sunday best, cardigans and fancy clip on earrings, hair sprayed like shellac. And i screamed and hugged her so tight and just kept telling her how much i loved her and miss her and she just kept patting me on the back saying it's ok and I was crying so hard and just wouldn't let her go. 😭❤️ it was so sweet omg."
